title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-tkjl: bulk reopening of ~260 previously-closed beads (human-closed issues reverted to open)
description:
Commit be583f03 bulk-reopens approximately 260 previously closed beads. Many of these were closed by humans (ec2-user/Mark Atwood) with close_reason documenting actual completed work. The commit strips `closed_at`, `close_reason`, `lease_expires_at`, and `heartbeat_at` fields and sets `status` back to "open" or "in_progress".

This is a data integrity regression:
1. Human-closed beads (owner: "me@mark.atwood.name", assignee: "ec2-user") that documented completed review findings and fixes are now "open" again
2. The audit trail (close reasons, closed_at timestamps) is lost
3. Issues like uugv, w4cp, zte2.9.1, etc. were explicitly closed by humans with detailed close reasons documenting resolution

Examples of reverted human closures:
- project-LICHEN-uugv: closed by ec2-user, now open
- project-LICHEN-w4cp: closed by ec2-user, now open
- project-LICHEN-zte2.9.1: closed by Mark Atwood (human), now in_progress
- project-LICHEN-ialj: closed by ec2-user (human), now open

The bead state should be restored to reflect actual completion status of these items.
